english.note: Use this when sincerity is shown through an effort, gesture, offer, or intention, especially in 有冇誠意.

examples.english: I can feel your sincerity in the gift you made especially for me.
examples.traditional: 你特登整咗呢份禮物，我感受到你嘅誠意。
